{"metadata":{"description":"Fully local vector memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: local embeddings, SQLite storage, automatic recall injection, dedup with conflict detection, soft-delete recycle bin, online backup.","id":"gh:1350137459","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-local-vector-memory","slug":"liangxiaobing520/dsh-local-vector-memory","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin","memory","vector-database"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Fully local vector memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: local embeddings, SQLite storage, automatic r"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ecall injection, dedup with conflict detection, soft-delete recycle bin, online backup."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-local-vector-memory"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"本地向量记忆插件 for DeepSeek Harness(DSH)。本地 embedding 向量化 + SQLite 单文件存储,对话自动召回注入;会话结束由 DeepSeek 云端 deepse"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"epSeek Harness(DSH)。本地 embedding 向量化 + SQLite 单文件存储,对话自动召回注入;会话结束由 DeepSeek 云端 deepseek-v4-pro 自动提取。"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"*A local-first vector memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: local embeddings, SQLite storage, automati"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"c recall injection, and DeepSeek cloud v4-pro extraction at session flush.*"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## 特性"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **写入三条路**:手动 `memory_add`;用户消息命中记忆线索(记住/以后/偏好/约定/不要…)时毫秒级自动捕获;DeepSeek 云端 deepseek-v4-pro 在会话结束时从整"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"段对话提取记忆(`autoExtract`,默认开)
- **防矛盾记忆**:写入时检测与已有记忆的冲突/过时(相似度 ≥0.86 但未达完全重复),提示改用 `memory_update` 更新旧记"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"忆而不是新增重复条目
- **回收站**:`memory_forget` 默认软删除,`memory_restore` 可恢复;`purge=true` 才永久删除
- **在线备份**:`memor"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"y_backup` 用 SQLite `VACUUM INTO` 生成一致性快照(安全于手工复制 WAL 库),默认保留 5 份
- **自动召回**:每次 agent 推理前检索 top-K 相关记"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"忆注入上下文(`<local-memory>` 标签),会话内 LRU 去重
- **批量向量化**:提取/重建索引一次 HTTP 批量请求,失败自动逐条回退
- **关键词兜底**:embeddin"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"g 服务不可用时退化为中英文关键词匹配,写入照常
- **本地存储**:向量库是单个 SQLite 文件(`node:sqlite`,Node ≥22.5);embedding 全本地,提取走 Dee"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"退化为中英文关键词匹配,写入照常
